title: 第3130章 自爆的魔族天骄第3129章 金蝉脱壳准备夺舍
slug: 全球守护灵开局获得东皇帝俊
content_zh:
这是一场发生在魔渊煞体内的、无声却凶险万分的战争。
他的身体表面开始出现不规则的隆起和凹陷，皮肤下仿佛有活物在激烈争斗。
魔气与一种诡异的灰绿色虫性能量交织，对冲，发出令人毛骨悚然的滋滋声。
布下的隐匿魔阵因为主人心神失守和能量暴走而剧烈波动，泄露出一丝异常的气息。
这丝气息虽然微弱，但在混乱的能量背景下并不起眼，却还是被某些存在敏锐地捕捉到了。
远处，正在与冥狱罗激烈争夺骸诡本源的叶修，血眸之中突然闪过一丝异色。
他对杀戮、死亡、吞噬类的气息最为敏感。
魔渊煞那边传来的气息……不对劲！
不仅仅是受伤的萎靡，更夹杂着一种混乱、挣扎、以及……另一种熟悉的、令人厌恶的虫族气息？
“牧万灵？还没死透？”叶修心中一动，瞬间明白了大概。
好一个金蝉脱壳，寄生夺舍！
这虫族天骄，果然阴险！
几乎同时，另一道隐晦的神念也扫过了这片区域，带着一丝惊疑和贪婪。
是妖月璃！
她也察觉到了魔渊煞那边的异常波动。
一个重伤且似乎陷入某种内部危机的魔渊煞？
这可是千载难逢的机会！
若能趁其病要其命，吞噬其本源，她的太阴噬月体必将大成！
还有影无痕，他虽然隐匿在阴影中，但对能量波动也极其敏感。
魔渊煞那边紊乱的气息，同样引起了他的注意。

一个可能油尽灯枯的顶尖天骄？
或许……有机会？
更远处，正在与叶天激战的敖苍古，与叶帝对峙的神御道。
与叶昊拼杀的仙临尘，与叶君对决的剑破虚。
与叶战厮杀的战不败，以及圣耀世、渡心等人，也都或多或少感应到了那不同寻常的波动，心思各异。
魔渊煞所在的那片混乱区域，不知不觉间，再次成为了风暴的潜在中心。
而此刻，魔渊煞体内的争夺已经到了最关键的时刻。
牧万灵的噬魂魔虫已经侵占了魔渊煞近半的肉身和部分神魂，魔渊煞的自我意识在疯狂反扑与吞噬中逐渐模糊。
但原始真魔的凶性也被彻底激发。
“一起死吧！虫子！”魔渊煞残存的意识发出最后的咆哮，他竟然不再抵抗牧万灵的侵蚀。
反而主动将剩余的魔体精华和神魂本源，连同牧万灵的寄生意志一起，疯狂灌入那摇摇欲坠的吞噬黑洞核心！
他要引爆吞噬黑洞，拉着牧万灵同归于尽！
就算不能彻底杀死这个诡异的虫子，也要重创其根本，让他无法顺利夺舍！
“不！你疯了！”牧万灵的意念惊恐尖叫，他没想到魔渊煞如此决绝。
轰——！！！
恐怖的吞噬之力在魔渊煞体内彻底失控，爆发！
他的身体如同一个被吹涨的气球，瞬间膨胀，皮肤寸寸裂开，露出下面交织的魔气与虫影！
content_en:
This is a silent but extremely dangerous war that takes place within Mo Yuansha's body.
Irregular ridges and depressions began to appear on the surface of his body, and it seemed as if there were living creatures fighting fiercely under the skin.
The demonic energy intertwined with a strange gray-green insect sexual energy, colliding with each other and making a creepy sizzling sound.
The hidden magic circle set up fluctuated violently due to the master's loss of concentration and energy runaway, leaking out a trace of abnormal aura.
Although this breath was weak, it was inconspicuous against the chaotic energy background, but it was still keenly captured by some beings.
In the distance, Ye Xiu, who was fiercely competing with Ming Yuluo for the origin of the corpse, suddenly had a strange color flash in his bloody eyes.
He is most sensitive to the smells of killing, death, and devouring.
The aura coming from Mo Yuansha's side... something's not right!
Not just the malaise of injury, but also mixed with a kind of confusion, struggle, and...another familiar, disgusting Zerg aura?
"Mu Wanling? Not dead yet?" Ye Xiu's heart moved, and he understood the general idea instantly.
What a golden cicada that sheds its shell and takes over its body as a parasite!
This Zerg genius is indeed insidious!
Almost at the same time, another obscure divine thought also swept across this area, with a hint of surprise and greed.
It's Yaoyueli!
She also noticed the abnormal fluctuations on Mo Yuansha's side.
A Mo Yuansha who was seriously injured and seemed to be in some kind of internal crisis?
This is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity!
If she can take advantage of her illness to kill her and devour her origin, her Taiyin Moon Devouring Body will definitely be completed!
There is also Ying Wuhen. Although he hides in the shadows, he is also extremely sensitive to energy fluctuations.
The chaotic aura of Mo Yuan Sha also attracted his attention.
A top genius who might be exhausted?
Maybe... there's a chance?
Further away, Ao Canggu was fighting fiercely with Ye Tian, ​​and Shen Yudao was confronting Ye Di.
Xian Linchen fights with Ye Hao, and Jian Poxu fights with Ye Jun.
Zhan Bubai, who was fighting with Ye Zhan, as well as Sheng Yaoshi, Du Xin and others, all more or less sensed the unusual fluctuations and had different thoughts.
The chaotic area where Mo Yuansha is located has unknowingly become the potential center of the storm again.
At this moment, the fight within Mo Yuansha's body has reached the most critical moment.
Mu Wanling's soul-eating demonic insects have invaded nearly half of Mo Yuan Sha's body and part of his soul. Mo Yuan Sha's self-consciousness gradually blurred in the crazy counterattack and devouring.
But the ferocity of the original demon was also completely aroused.
"Let's die together! Insects!" Mo Yuansha's remaining consciousness let out the last roar, and he no longer resisted Mu Wanling's erosion.
Instead, he took the initiative to pour the remaining essence of the demonic body and the origin of the divine soul, together with Mu Wanling's parasitic will, into the core of the crumbling devouring black hole!
He will detonate a devouring black hole and drag Mu Wanling to death with him!
Even if this weird bug cannot be completely killed, its roots must be severely damaged so that it cannot successfully seize its body!
"No! You are crazy!" Mu Wanling screamed in horror. He did not expect Mo Yuan Sha to be so decisive.
boom--! ! !
The terrifying devouring power completely lost control in Mo Yuansha's body and exploded!
His body was like an inflated balloon, inflating instantly, and his skin split open inch by inch, revealing the intertwined demonic energy and insect shadows underneath!
